correctness.rationale: The direct semantics on upset X_t gives i in Box X_t iff t<=b_i and i in Diamond X_t iff t<=d_i, with b,d suffix minima of alpha=max_U min(U) and gamma=min_U max(U). Since suffix minima on a finite chain are nondecreasing, every frame has a unique monotone pair and every pair is realized by a single interval if b_i<=d_i or two singleton sets otherwise. D axiom is exactly b_i<=d_i coordinatewise; every D-valid type has a serial single-interval relational representative. The ordered-pair count is choose(2n-1,n)^2. D-valid pairs biject to 2xn semistandard tableaux, counted by Jacobi-Trudi det = choose(2n,n)^2/[2(n+1)]. This is exact all-n proof; independent exhaustive monotone-pair census n=1..5 gives (1,1),(9,6),(100,50),(1225,490),(15876,5292). The disjoint raw neighborhood family {{0,2},{1}} on C3 validates D by direct threshold evaluation.
